sn12.72-81:10.1: Saṅkhāre na pajānanti || saṅkhārasamudayam na pajānanti || saṅkhāranirodhaṃ na pajānanti || saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ na pajānanti || pe|| || Pajānanti || pe|| || sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || || Ekādasamam || || Samaṇabrāhmaṇa-vaggo aṭṭhamo || ||
sn12.72-81:11.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Paccayekādasā vuttā || catusaccavibhajjanā || Samaṇabrāhmaṇavaggo || nidāne bhavati aṭṭhamaṃ || || Ayaṃ
sn12.72-81:12.0: vaggassa uddānaṃ || || Buddho Āhāra Dasabalaṃ || Kaḷāraṃ Gahapati pañcamam || Rukkhavaggo Mahāvaggo || Aṭṭhamam Samaṇa-brāhmaṇanti || ||
